description: Dynamic capture matrix. Tracks the minimum evidence rounds required per UI phase before any protocol field may be considered proven. Evidence is evaluated only; nothing here authorizes a login, purchase, or battle action.

phases.description: Process launch, first-screen consent, and permissions screens. Proves only that the target process exists and which sockets it opens before login.

gate.notes: A successful round needs a PID/UID-owned socket snapshot plus a Frida session-started event. No non-443 game endpoint is expected at this phase.

phases.description: Login page submit through result and transition to lobby. Account protocol work requires a repeated non-443 endpoint across two sessions.

gate.notes: If only MSDK/TDM/GCloud HTTPS (443) appears, account protocol remains unproven. Direction and timing must correlate with the login action.

phases.description: Lobby loaded baseline used to compare against room, match, shop, and battle traffic.

gate.notes: Baseline is needed to distinguish persistent control-plane sockets from phase-specific game sockets.

phases.description: Shop open, item list load, and purchase confirmation. No real purchase unless explicitly authorized for a disposable item.

gate.notes: Pass needs request/response correlation and a response that precedes the UI result in two sessions. Cached-list traffic alone fails the gate.

phases.description: Training or lowest-risk battle only. Never ranked or account-affecting battle during a first capture.

gate.notes: Pass needs a persistent or distinct battle endpoint, increased bidirectional traffic, and at least three comparable frame samples. Telemetry-only capture fails.
